entry: Compare all lists button on the parts page; Back to parts returns to the gallery
scope: Exact parts across Basic, NI/Compact, McGinley, SONIC and the two budget candidates
source_handling: Each comparison cell uses the original list entry's line price, quantity, estimate flag, seller/date and source URL. OmniMic uses its recorded retailer catalog price link. Product names/functions/groups are shared with the gallery. USB-6361 connector variants and MF1/MF2 remain separate; ED1 enclosure/power bundle remains intact. No compatibility or performance ranking is implied.

verification.tests: 11/11 existing model, budget and photo checks passed
verification.syntax: app.js, parts.js and compare.js passed node --check
verification.static: Source validation, static build and git diff --check passed; pinned manuscript unchanged
verification.browser: Codex in-app browser through the supported CUA API, local HTTP preview
verification.contents: 37 unique DOM row IDs and 37 images. Rendered price-cell counts and sums match all five source lists. No loaded image failures observed.
verification.layout: No page horizontal overflow. On desktop all five lists fit. Smaller layouts scroll inside the table; product names, column headings and totals stay visible. First and last columns were inspected at the narrowest width.
verification.interaction: Horizontal and vertical table scrolling, Back to parts, Compare all lists, active Parts navigation, direct #compare, legacy #experiment and #results routes passed.
verification.source_check: OmniMic numeric price link resolves to its recorded Parts Express catalog URL; two reference-photo labels remain visible.
verification.visual_review: Default desktop, tablet and both phone sizes inspected. Browser captures remain temporary.

evidence_boundary: Prices retain their dated observation/estimate basis. Dash means not listed in that option, not unnecessary. Candidate subtotal includes only two devices and omits NI/connections. This page adds no sound, hardware control, purchase, bench result or animal protocol.
